name: iPOSpays Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: iPOSPays

sections.description:
The iPOSpays Payment Gateway for WooCommerce enables merchants to securely accept Credit/Debit Cards, ACH (Bank), Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, and other supported payment methods through Embedded and Hosted Payment Page (HPP) checkout experiences.

Supported Payment Methods (Hosted Payment Page – Redirect)

  • Credit/Debit Cards
  • Google Pay
  • Apple Pay
  • ACH (Bank)
  • Alternative Payment Methods

Supported Payment Methods (Embedded Checkout)

  • Credit/Debit Cards
  • Google Pay
  • Apple Pay
  • ACH (Bank)

To use Google Pay, customers must use a supported browser such as Google Chrome.

To use Apple Pay, customers must use a supported Apple device and Safari browser.

For Embedded Checkout, you must whitelist your domain: How to Setup Whitelisted Domain on iPOSpays

Demo

View all supported payment methods:

Demo Store

Google Pay Support

iPOSpays supports Google Pay, allowing customers to complete secure and fast payments using their Google Account on supported mobile and desktop devices.

Google Pay Privacy Policy and Google Pay Terms of Service

Apple Pay Support

iPOSpays supports Apple Pay, enabling customers to complete fast and secure payments using Apple devices.

To enable Apple Pay, merchants must have an Apple Developer Account and register their domain with Apple. How to set up Apple Pay for Your iPOSpays Merchant Account

Apple Pay Privacy Policy and Apple Pay Terms of Service
sections.faq:
How do I test this plugin?

Enable Test Mode in the plugin settings to simulate payment transactions.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Currently, WooCommerce Subscriptions are not supported. We may consider adding support in a future release.

Where can I find documentation?

You can find our detailed documentation here.

Where can I get support?

Please use the WordPress Plugin Support Forum.
sections.changelog:
1.4.5 – 2026-08-19

New
* Added VeriCheck ACH payment processor support.
* Added Plugin Uninstall Survey.
* Added permanent uninstall event logging.

Improvements
* Added support for 9-digit ZIP Codes in ACH transactions.
* Added Birth Year validation for ACH transactions.
* Improved ACH checkout and form rendering.
* Improved plugin uninstall cleanup.

Security
* Enhanced payment security and input validation.
* Improved API security and request handling.
* Strengthened overall plugin stability and security.
* Resolved issues identified during the security assessment.

1.4.0 – 2026-06-15

Security Enhancements
* Migrated the payment gateway from PHP session-based data transport to a secure, cache-safe sessionless architecture.

See changelog for all versions
